representation: Fresh Morgan radius 2 / 2048 bits; no prior model assets
threshold_policy: Maximize inner OOF bootstrap mean MCC on all supplied labels; no positive-count constraint
training_policy: Keep all supplied labels. Weight interval-supported training labels 1; unresolved labels 0.25. Multiclass distinguishes ordinary and inferred positives, then sums their molecular probabilities.
diagnostic_motivation: 903 of 1364 direct-active D6 labels have paired marginal shift intervals crossing log10(2); test whether confidence weighting and separate positive mechanisms improve new learning.
excluded_inputs: Every prior model and prediction, including pilot model assets. Only source compounds, measurements and aliases are allowed.
status: Sequential foundational hypothesis test; validation labels are never reweighted or relabelled; no upload
